name: Federated States of Micronesia
title: Ceyo | AI Agents for Federated States of Micronesia
description: Deploy 24/7 autonomous AI agents in Micronesia. Run cloud computers, automate maritime logistics, tourism, and remote workflows from Pohnpei to Yap with Ceyo.
sub: Equip your business with autonomous AI agents that run on dedicated cloud computers 24/7, keeping your operations active across all four island states even when you are offline.
audience: Maritime shipping coordinators, dive and eco-resort operators, fisheries exporters, municipal departments, and remote professionals across Pohnpei, Chuuk, Yap, and Kosrae.
manifesto: Spanning thousands of ocean miles across four island states, your work cannot afford downtime. Ceyo provides persistent cloud intelligence that tracks cargo, automates guest bookings, and coordinates workflows across Pacific time zones without pause.

uses.d: Manage inquiries and reservations 24/7 for Chuuk Lagoon dive operations and Pohnpei surf expeditions, syncing directly with calendars and email.
Use autonomous browser agents to monitor shipping manifests, port berthing schedules in Kolonia and Weno, and carrier status updates.
Coordinate catch logs, export documentation, and regional market pricing through automated daily routines connected to your shared drives.
Draft reporting documents, format statistical records, and manage cross-departmental filing between state offices and national agencies in Palikir.
Deploy coding agents that write, execute, and host operational software directly inside cloud environments without local infrastructure limits.
Assemble specialized multi-bot Telegram groups to dispatch weather alerts, monitor inventory, and share research reports across distributed island teams.

steps.d: Select your plan and boot your private 24/7 cloud workstation in under a minute.
Link Telegram, email, and your favorite workspace apps with built-in integrations.
Assign research, web navigation, coding, and routine tasks that run continuously.

chapters.d: Your agent checks regional shipping portals and weather advisories across Pohnpei and Chuuk. A clear summary sits ready in your Telegram channel before breakfast.
While you conduct meetings in Kolonia, your bot responds to international booking requests, verifies room availability, and updates booking spreadsheets.
Your coding agent compiles inventory reports from satellite branches across Yap and Kosrae, flagging discrepancies and filing cloud backups.
Even after your devices disconnect from the network, your isolated cloud computer continues running market research and web monitoring tasks.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every tier includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is only billed after the trial ends unless canceled.

faq.q: Do my bots keep running if my internet disconnects?
faq.a: Yes. Each bot operates within its own dedicated cloud computer independent of your local network or phone battery. Your tasks, scripts, and automations continue 24/7 even during local power or internet outages.

faq.q: Can I manage my bots through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can interact directly with your personal bots on Telegram or add multiple specialized bots into group chats to collaborate on research, customer support, and project management.

faq.q: What languages and tasks do Ceyo bots support?
faq.a: Ceyo agents communicate fluently in English and dozens of world languages. They can browse the web, write and debug software, execute data analysis in Google Sheets, make scheduled phone calls, and manage crypto transactions.

faq.q: How does Ceyo connect with external business tools?
faq.a: Ceyo natively integrates with over 1,000 tools including Gmail, Google Drive, Notion, Slack, and leading CRM platforms, allowing your agents to read documents, update records, and trigger workflows automatically.
